regions.merged_text: Thank you for the kind favor of November 20. The Mass for your dear mother was said yesterday. Please understand God is a good Father. He knows what is best for our souls. So no mat- ter what He gives, sickness, health or even death, He does so for our best interests. So whatever lie does, praise His holy Name. God bless you, your mother, and those close to you.
